_source: What ansible.builtin.command registers (ansible-core 2.19.2) for `rsyslogd -N1 -f /etc/rsyslog.conf` on disposable vm-target VMs, Ubuntu 24.04 and AlmaLinux 9 with their stock /etc/rsyslog.conf, after writing each case's config files to /etc/rsyslog.d (captured 2026-10-16 04:24 UTC). Under "ansible": rsyslogd moved away, and the task skipped by `when: false` (Ubuntu, 04:27 UTC). Only the keys the rescue reads are kept, verbatim.
